name: Masco Corporation
sector: Capital Goods / Building products & home improvement
moat_justification: Leading branded positions (Delta/Hansgrohe plumbing, Behr paint exclusive at Home Depot since 1978, Hot Spring spas) with pro-channel preference and proven pricing power; ROIC proxy stayed 0.44-0.53 over 2021-25 through a revenue downturn and gross margin held 31.3-36.2%. Capped at 7: no consumer switching costs at the shelf, Behr's Home Depot concentration, and housing/R&R cyclicality the brands could not offset (revenue fell 2022-25).
fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 10 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
BUYBACK_TAILWIND: share count shrinking 3.3%/yr — already credited via the growth adjustment
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.5x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high
TIER_BAND: bear-case tier D (6.3%) vs bull-case tier C (10.3%) — the verdict spans tiers; size any position to the bear end
one_liner: High-quality branded building-products franchise, moat 7/10 — does not clear 15% at $72.87 (weighted IRR 8.6%, weighted IV@15% $34.91); it clears 15% only at or below $34.91, and even the bull case is just 10.3%.
moat_for: ROIC proxy 0.44-0.53 every year 2021-25, well above cost of capital through a downturn
Behr paint's exclusive Home Depot distribution since 1978 and Delta/Hansgrohe pro-channel preference
Proven pricing power: gross margin held 31.3-36.2% and expanded in Q2 2026 while volumes fell
#1/#2 branded positions (Delta, Behr, Hansgrohe, Hot Spring) in repair-and-remodel categories driven by an aging housing stock
moat_against: No real switching costs: DIY consumers can switch paint/faucet brands at the shelf (Sherwin-Williams, Moen, Kohler, private label)
Customer concentration: Behr sells exclusively through Home Depot in North America
Housing and repair-and-remodel cyclicality: revenue fell from $8.680B (2022) to $7.562B (2025) despite the brands
Tariff and commodity exposure on imported plumbing components and paint inputs
